stage: S1 pretrained SHARP learned explicit Gaussian visible layer

statistics.PSNR: poolfloat64SSE/(3validpixels), then -10log10; independently per scene/focus, each aperture also reported
statistics.patch_pool: whole unmasked fixed64px grid weighted by regional pixel support
statistics.RGB: standard displayRGBfloat[0,1];raw linearEXR retained;3D integrates true linearRGB
statistics.full_image: all pixels including sky and peeled-reference residuals

quality.direction: PSNRgain>0 AND LPIPSchange<-3noise;absLPIPSchange<=3noise is tie,not direction improvement or significant deterioration
quality.guardrails: per-focus pooled full-image and in-focus PSNR versusO3 each drop<=0.2dB; individual cases also reported

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

reuse_frame1.reason: fixed predetermined final budget;not heldout-selected;old overfit decision remains inhistorical record

R2.stopping: historicalbest includesinitial monitor;stop ifheldoutPSNR <=best_seen-0.5dB for3 consecutive monitors OR any nonfinite loss/optimization value;train-minus-heldout gap reportedonly
R2.final_selection: fixed step8000 only ifstop rule nottriggered;never select checkpoint byheldout

methods.U1: learned nonnegative radiance,may>1, fixed sameband O6-GT-rec hidden,Cfill,K64
methods.U1_clip: same fitted visible Gaussians butclip visible linear colors[0,1] before rendering;hidden unchanged
methods.controls: sameoptimized visible without hidden for eachcolor mode;O3 andunoptimized L2

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

Cycles.worth_training: at least onefocus passes formal_method_value AND pooled full-image PSNR gain overO3>=0.5dB AND full-image LPIPS not worse beyond3noise

full_noise_source.rule: absolute difference <=3 times maximum independent-pair whole-image patch LPIPS at same lens and formal B2 SPP, frames1/30; frame60 uses maximum; existing B2 noise record only

LDR.criteria: same form asoriginal U1, new per-region max-pair reference noise
LDR.worth_training: atleast onefocus passes formalvalue AND full-image gain>=0.5dB versusO3 AND full-image LPIPS worsening<=3newfullnoise

R2.radiance_analysis: fraction anyRGB>1,projected spatialdensity;fraction/enrichment within3px (7x7dilation) of inputEXR pixels anyRGB>1;analysis only,not supervision

band.definition: 3x3 relative inverse-depth jump, union of max-local-CoC1.5x footprints; exclusively target current visible depth
band.primary_evaluation: band excluding previously flagged peeled-reference residual pixels;band itself is never GT-filtered
band.report: independent disocclusionGT recall/precision/FP/FN, unknownGT support and CoC distribution; no tuning toGT recall

high_light_influence.definition: max_RGB abs(S(Cycles_linear)-R_LDR)>0.02 in displayRGB; no dilation
high_light_influence.report: imagefraction,counts,spatial heatmap/connectedcomponent distribution and overlapwith frozen scoringregions;also influenced/uninfluenced scores
high_light_influence.not_pure_light_ground_truth: difference also includes finiteK andMC noise;not used to selectmethod content

references.primary: unchanged Cycles full-scene GT at nominal1.4/5m
references.auxiliary: unchanged R1 LDR consistent mean64; no new reference generation
references.noise: existing R2 Cycles lens noise and R1 max independent-pair LDR noise

inference.official: unmodified sharp.cli.predict.predict_image with create_predictor(PredictorParams()) strict checkpoint
inference.input: original LDR displayRGB float32*255 passed into official /255 preprocessing; avoids extra uint8 quantization
inference.frames: all13 exactly once: 3 representative Gaussian clouds and other10 input depths required by specified retrieval; no inference on extra frames
inference.coordinates: official OpenCV xright ydown zforward, retain target-local camera coordinates; renderer E=identity, K dataset 512; retrieval poses define same target-local coordinates
inference.colors: retain official in-memory linearRGB; do not decode public PLY as linear because official PLY export stores sRGB
inference.layer_definition: official composer flatten B,N,H,W,C, first contiguous half block0=front,second half block1=back; no per-point depth reranking; diagnose crossings and overlapping visible support

first_layer_depth.definition: alpha-normalized expected axial depth of block0 rendered at512 with shared AA eps2d0.0015, positive finite depth andalpha>=0.1
first_layer_depth.holes: nearest valid input-derived depth via scipy distance_transform_edt; record filled pixels, no GT fill or sky labels
first_layer_depth.GT_error: full finite GTvisible pixels and7x7 depth-edge band; report filled-depth errors and original support

scale.diagnostic: one scalar S=median(GT visible axial depths pooled3 representativeframes)/median(SHARP front depths at same finite positive GTvisible pixels); no per-frame fit
scale.apply: same S to all13 depths and Gaussian means/scales; same S and focus rule for O3_SHARP; Oracle diagnostic only, separate from formal main decisions

target_focus.rule: median used method depth inside original R3 GT in-focus mask at nominal focus/current aperture; GT mask simulates user-selected target only
target_focus.shared: O3_SHARP,VG_SHARP,SHARP front/full andretrieval variants share the same front-depth scalar percase/scale; cached O3_DA3/VG_DA3 retain original R3 depth/focus
target_focus.score_masks: original nominal GT scoring masks unchanged

fill.rule: same U2 input-side depth-band mask and background-depth extension + fixed LaMa; recompute SHARP mask/fill from its own depth where needed, not GT segmentation/hidden depth
fill.sharing: per frame/scale one fill and background depth for VG_SHARP/front/full/retrieval E1/E2, same per-ray lookup; native fill never receives Oracle S
fill.compositing: merge visible/back/retrieved Gaussians, depth-sorted alpha on each lens ray, residualT*Cfill, linear mean64; retrieved hidden active only outputband, no opaque LaMa covering hidden

variants.E2: cached single-Sim3-aligned DA3 input poses, no new alignment or GT correction

retrieval.rule: same L3: other12 only, behind target visible depth bymax1mm/0.5%; nearest depth layer, median RGB/depth within1%; no dynamics compensation or GT hidden filtering
retrieval.band: target estimated SHARP depth discontinuity,1.5x CoC at target-selected focus; no GT hidden/evaluation mask

comparisons.guardrails: full andin_focus PSNR>=-0.2dB vs O3_SHARP for same-depth main/hidden comparisons, vs O3_DA3 for secondary
comparisons.gate: same L2/R2 band PSNR>=0.5dB OR LPIPSdrop>=10% and>3noise; secondarymetric no PSNRdrop>0.2 or LPIPSworsening>3noise; >=5/6 PSNRpositive AND LPIPSdrop>3case-noise; 6 groups each>=1000px; guardrails
comparisons.recoverable: same local quality/direction reported independently; band is primary gate, recoverable not additional conjunction
comparisons.Oracle: same comparisons described separately, never replace native formal verdict

zero_aperture.check: front/full vs input RGB all/focus/boundary; direct original-SHARP rasterizer vs project export at identical classic eps0 settings, compare RGB/alpha/depth; then shared AA renderer
zero_aperture.alignment: OpenCV K and point projection agree; gross RGB mismatch is diagnosed before expansion; front alone may be transparent because layers learned jointly, not automatically an interface failure

cracks.fill: mean_k(Tk*Cfill_k) linearRGB contribution, regional per-channel mean and L1 share of final RGB, including crack subset

flypoints.GT_edge: relative inverse-depth jump>3% in3x3, dilate3px; local7x7 finite GTdepth min/max
flypoints.selection: projected Gaussian mean inside edge band, z between GTlocalmin+max5mm/1%min andGTlocalmax-max5mm/1%max
flypoints.contribution: center K1 per-Gaussian membership tag alpha-weighted contribution, no fill; separate from K64 DOF metric; report count andopacity-weighted fraction

back.in_band: central projection of layer1 means in method band, count and opacity-weighted
back.GT_consistency: minimum hidden depth at projected pixel from existing two-peel parent surfaces, matchwithinmax5mm/2%GT depth; supported count denominator explicit, evaluator only
back.depth_crossings: paired layer1 z<=layer0 z counted; no ordering correction

limits: one controlledscene,3frames,6 groups/focus; pretrained SHARP diagnostic component notfinal method
native metric main; global GT scale Oracle separate; no claim commercial use allowed
block1 is a network output layer, not guaranteed exclusively hidden surfaces; contributions shared with visible reconstruction
GTdepth only for score,target selection and declared global Oracle scale; E1 poses explicit allowed variant
